dek: National, global, and tech briefing for citizens and pastors. Civic week lives on RESOLUTE Local. Sports and weather have their own pages.

weather.label: Weather
weather.dek: Fredericksburg NWS — readiness, not climate talk

lead.hed: USNI: Northern Viking is underway in Iceland. An exercise is not a GIUK garrison.
lead.insight: USNI Thursday file, still the clock Friday PM: the U.S., Iceland, and NATO began biennial Northern Viking 2026 on Tuesday; it runs in Iceland and surrounding waters through Sept. 3. Seventy-fifth year of the 1951 U.S.–Iceland defense agreement. DVIDS: opening at Keflavik Aug. 18. A kickoff is not a permanent base.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Chief Petty Officer Justin Stumberg · DVIDS 9875057 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · Iceland Foreign Minister Þorgerður Katrín Gunnarsdóttir speaks at the Northern Viking 26 opening ceremony, Keflavik Air Base, Aug. 18, 2026
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of the NV26 opening ceremony at Keflavik. Same-subject class as Friday's Northern Viking lead — not a GIUK patrol photo, not a brand tile. Caption must say Aug. 18 ceremony, not today's AOR.

political.hed: USNI: Taiwan MPs drill Taipei. A metro storm-out is not a war plan.
political.insight: USNI, Friday: two ROC Military Police platoons left Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center metro in torrential rain and new grey camo, then set crew-served machine guns. A drill is not the defense of the capital. A photo line is not an order.

political.hed: Heritage: tariff the Chinese cargo ship. A levy is not a yard-sale tax.
political.insight: Heritage, Friday: the administration is adapting tariffs to spare household budgets — hit the Chinese cargo ship, not the American consignment shop. A commentary is not a customs rule. Affordability talk is not a signed annex.

political.hed: Heritage: fewer Taiwan Strait transits. A quieter strait is not a quieter PLA.
political.insight: Heritage, Thursday: after December 2025 Chinese exercises around Taiwan featured a mock air-and-naval blockade, a pair of U.S. ships made the first 2026 Strait transit weeks later. The question is whether fewer sails change the blockade math. A commentary is not a transit log.

tech.hed: Defense News: India asked into France’s sixth-gen jet. Talks are not a workshare.
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday 12:52: India’s Defense Ministry told parliament it has “initiated efforts in a concerted manner to co-join” France’s Future Combat Air System after Paris and Berlin dropped their joint fighter. Talks are not IP. A mock-up is not a jet.

tech.hed: USNI Pulse: North Korea lofted about 10 SRBMs. A count is not a campaign.
tech.insight: USNI Friday Western Pacific Pulse: North Korea launched about 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the Sea of Japan Thursday at 5 p.m., South Korea’s Joint Chiefs said. A weekly pulse is not a Pentagon confirm. Ten launches are not a new war.

tech.hed: Defense News: Navy posted a next-gen SeaSparrow ask. A Sources Sought is not a missile.
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the Navy is leading a 12-nation NATO SeaSparrow Project Office hunt for an NSV variant — sea-skimmer to high-diver, massed salvos, jamming. Deadline Oct. 19. Ten-inch max, Mark 41 fit. A notice is not a buy. Paper is not a round in the cell.

watch.hed: WATCH: Ulchi Freedom Shield ends today. A shorter drill is not a new treaty.
watch.insight: Defense News Wednesday file, still the clock Friday PM: allies cut Ulchi Freedom Shield from 11 days to five — ends Friday, Aug. 21, not Aug. 27. Some live events cancelled or moved to simulations. Kim Yo Jong still called it provocative. A shorter calendar is not a treaty rewrite.

watch.hed: WATCH: the Army is ending a Europe drone battalion. An experiment is not a TO&E.
watch.insight: Defense News Friday AM lead, retired to Watch: an Army official said the experimental drone battalion in Europe ends after Exercise Saber Junction in August and September, then returns to its airborne infantry mission. The statement did not name the unit. An experiment ending is not a drone freeze.

watch.hed: WATCH: George Washington is in CENTCOM. A hull in the AOR is not a campaign.
watch.insight: USNI Thursday file: USS George Washington (CVN-73) arrived in the CENTCOM area Wednesday with cruiser USS Robert Smalls and destroyer USS Shoup. Presence is not a strike order. Thursday PM lead, still the file Friday afternoon.
